indicator_definition: Forest area as a percentage of total land area, covering forests and other wooded land. Monitors changes due to land use change, afforestation and deforestation. Data compiled by Eurostat from national forestry statistics.
rationale: Forests are essential for biodiversity, carbon sequestration and livelihoods. Progress means maintaining or increasing the share of land covered by forests.
methodology_characteristics: Data compiled from national forestry statistics under the Joint Forest Sector Questionnaire (JFSQ). Forest area defined per FAO criteria. Published periodically by Eurostat.
indicator_name: Forest area as share of total land area
graph_title: Forest area as share of total land area
